suite.unsupported_reason: Fitness is accelerator wall-clock or model training on GPU hardware (CIFAR-10 decision-based adversarial attack); it cannot be measured on a CPU-only suite.

limitations: No official runnable repository was verified from the paper/project sources examined.
Upstream commands and dependencies were inspected; costly training, paid APIs, and hardware experiments were not executed.

The matching pgg3/L-AutoDA repository has no README/license in the inspected tree; run_attack.py defaults to BoundaryAttack and evaluates only one batch, so it is not a paper evaluation command without changes.
Official L-AutoDA release pinned; the attack evaluation needs PyTorch and RobustBench model downloads.
Execution interface inspected in pinned source. Full paper experiments have not been reproduced here.
